description: Bicycle volume and speed - historical is a dataset listed in Victorian Government Data Directory (discover.data.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Transport and Planning. Cycling flows in both directions recorded at 42 off-road counter sites and 4 on-road counter sites. Coverage: Victoria. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Transport and Planning . Its tags are bike, cycling, speed, volume. It offers 11 resource(s) in csv, zip. The portal shows 2024-12-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-vic-portal.
